viewing_check: Check slab length, width and thickness, whether the wood smells and looks like true Huon pine (fine even grain, golden tinge on fresh surface, distinctive scent) versus celery top or similar, and the extent of knots, voids and cracks. Neighbouring lots 1114 and 1116 look alike.
